name: Dolls Kill
description: Online fashion retailer aimed at Gen Z 'misfits', selling edgy clothing, shoes, accessories and costumes through dollskill.com; its sales are heavily driven by TikTok Shop affiliates and it appeared on the owner's TikTok Shop lead sheet.

evidence.summary: Lasso lists a Dolls Kill affiliate program at 8% per sale with a 30-day cookie, joining via Viglink/Sovrn; that is a secondary route, so no single rate is recorded for the primary TikTok Shop route.

Publicly shared TikTok Shop analytics for Dolls Kill (Oct-Nov 2026) show $10.17M revenue in 30 days, $8.59M of it from affiliates, 117.2k items sold and about 3.32k active affiliates - creator scale in the thousands, so saturation is honestly unknown, not low.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure Gen Z fashion - clothing, shoes, costumes and accessories built for TikTok try-on and haul content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Affiliates drive the majority of its TikTok Shop revenue ($8.59M of $10.17M in one 30-day window) with thousands of active creators.
reasons.compensation: TikTok Shop commission is set per product and not published as one program rate; a secondary Sovrn route is listed at 8%, so no rate is recorded and no cap is stated anywhere fetched.
reasons.contact_access: No published partnerships or creator email was found on the pages fetched; access is through TikTok Shop and network dashboards.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate selling on TikTok Shop today, plus a network route via Sovrn/Viglink.
reasons.credibility: Large, long-running online fashion retailer with very high social-commerce volume.

name: PacSun
description: California-born youth retailer (Pacific Sunwear of California) selling denim, tops, swim, activewear and accessories to teens and young adults through pacsun.com and mall stores; it appeared on the owner's TikTok Shop lead sheet.

evidence.summary: Snippet's check of PacSun's own pages (November 14, 2026) states: 'Apply to PacSun Affiliate Program on Impact. That is the creator route PacSun publishes.'

Published rates conflict across sources and eras - Lasso lists 1% per sale with a 7-day cookie, older Rakuten-era reviews cite 2-4%, Shopper lists 9.6% and an LTK roundup 10.5% - so commission_rate is null with the conflict documented here.
PacSun lists pressinquiries@pacsun.com for media questions; Snippet notes it is a press inbox, not a creator route.

reasons.niche_fit: Core teen and young-adult fashion - denim, swim, festival and streetwear styles made for social content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: PacSun publishes an affiliate program on Impact as its creator route and is a staple of LTK creator roundups.
reasons.compensation: Reported rates conflict from 1% to 10.5% depending on source and era, so no rate is recorded; no earnings cap is stated anywhere fetched.
reasons.contact_access: A published press email exists and the Impact application is the documented creator route, but there is no dedicated creator inbox.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Joinable through Impact today per Snippet's check of PacSun's own pages.
reasons.credibility: Long-established national mall and online retailer with strong Gen Z recognition.

name: Hotels.com
description: Expedia Group's hotel booking platform, founded in 1991, selling stays at properties in over 200 countries through hotels.com and dozens of localized sites, known for its reward-nights loyalty scheme.

evidence.summary: AffiliateProgramsGuru (verified April 2026) documents the Hotels.com program at up to 4% per completed stay through CJ Affiliate and the direct Expedia Group Affiliate Program, with a 7-day cookie and payment after the guest checks out.

LinkClicky's CJ record shows a 0%-4% range by booking type (1% on gift cards per other roundups) and some roundups cite 4-6%; the recorded 4% is the widely published headline rate for completed stays.
Hotels.com has been an online travel agency since 1991 and is an Expedia Group company, with one of the largest hotel inventories of any booking platform.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure travel - hotel stays are a staple of travel-creator content and itinerary recommendations.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A standard booking link in travel blogs and creator content, though Hotels.com runs no visible creator-first program of its own.
reasons.compensation: Up to 4% per completed stay via CJ on high average booking values ($250-$400 reported); no earnings cap is stated anywhere fetched.
reasons.contact_access: No published creator or partnerships contact was found; access is through the CJ Affiliate advertiser listing.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to publishers through CJ Affiliate and the Expedia Group program today.
reasons.credibility: One of the oldest and largest hotel booking platforms in the world, inside Expedia Group.

name: Nordstrom
description: Seattle department-store company founded in 1901, selling designer and contemporary clothing, shoes, accessories and beauty through nordstrom.com, its full-line stores and Nordstrom Rack.

evidence.summary: NichePursuits, quoting Nordstrom's own site, confirms Rakuten manages the program: commissions are paid monthly and 'Rakuten will issue you the referral fees generated on net sales of products shipped throughout that month', with a $25 minimum.

Published figures conflict widely - Lasso/FlexOffers list 0.8% per sale, while other roundups cite 1-6%, 1-11%, 2-11% and 2-20% by category - so commission_rate is null with the conflict documented here.

reasons.niche_fit: Premium department-store fashion across clothing, shoes and beauty - a core LTK and fashion-creator retailer.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A fixture of fashion-creator link programs (LTK, Rakuten) and seasonal sale content such as the Anniversary Sale.
reasons.compensation: Rates conflict from 0.8% to 20% depending on network and category, so no rate is recorded; no earnings cap is stated anywhere fetched.
reasons.contact_access: No published creator contact was found; access is through the Rakuten Advertising advertiser listing, which is selective.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Joinable through Rakuten Advertising, though approval is known to be selective about site quality.
reasons.credibility: Century-old, publicly traded US department-store institution.

name: J.Crew
description: American apparel retailer selling classic women's, men's and kids' clothing, shoes and accessories through jcrew.com and its stores, known for a timeless preppy aesthetic.

evidence.summary: UpPromote documents the J.Crew affiliate program as managed through third-party networks - CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) and FlexOffers - at a reported 2.4% to 3% per sale.
Lasso's J.Crew US record lists 2.3% per sale with a 3-day cookie, LinkApprove lists 5% and Shopper 1% - conflicting figures, so commission_rate is null with the conflict documented here.

reasons.niche_fit: Classic American apparel for women, men and kids - steady fashion-creator territory.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A regular in creator link roundups and outfit content, though the brand runs no visible creator-first program page.
reasons.compensation: Reported rates conflict between 1% and 5% across network records, so no rate is recorded; no earnings cap is stated anywhere fetched.
reasons.contact_access: No published creator or partnerships contact was found; access is network-only.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Joinable through CJ Affiliate and FlexOffers listings today.

name: Briggs & Riley
description: American premium luggage maker selling suitcases, backpacks and business cases engineered for frequent travelers and backed by a lifetime guarantee, through briggs-riley.com.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's CJ Affiliate record lists Briggs & Riley at 9% per sale on CJ Affiliate, described as 'just what's officially listed with their affiliate program'.
Lasso lists 7.2% per sale with a 30-day cookie and Shopper lists 4%, conflicting with the 9% CJ record and older 9-10% roundups, so commission_rate is null with the conflict documented here.
Briggs & Riley luggage is 'engineered for reality and guaranteed for life', runs its program through Commission Junction, and reports an average order value of almost $330.

reasons.niche_fit: Premium luggage and travel bags - squarely in the travel-gear niche for packing and carry-on content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-standing pick in travel-blogger luggage roundups, though not a social-first creator brand.
reasons.compensation: Reported rates conflict between 4% and 10% across records, so no rate is recorded; the reported range is decent on a ~$330 average order, and no cap is stated anywhere fetched.
reasons.contact_access: No published creator or partnerships contact was found; access is through the CJ advertiser listing.
reasons.credibility: Established premium travelware brand of 30+ years with a lifetime guarantee.

name: Cadence
description: Direct-to-consumer brand selling a system of magnetic, refillable capsules for toiletries and personal care, designed to streamline travel and daily routines, through keepyourcadence.com.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky records Cadence's affiliate program on ShareASale at 10% per sale with a 15-day cookie, described as 'just what's officially listed with their affiliate program'.
SimplyCodes describes Cadence's system of magnetic, refillable capsules designed to help shoppers streamline their travel and daily routines, sold direct at keepyourcadence.com.

reasons.niche_fit: Travel toiletry capsules sit between travel and beauty routines - a narrower but real fit for packing and routine content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A social-native DTC product frequently shown in packing and routine videos, with an open ShareASale program.
reasons.compensation: A clean, officially listed 10% per sale on ShareASale; no earnings cap is stated anywhere fetched, so the cap is honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No published creator or partnerships contact was found; access is through ShareASale.
reasons.credibility: Small, young DTC brand - established product and press, but a fraction of the scale of the retailers in this group.

name: Hello Molly
description: Australian online women's fashion retailer selling trend-driven dresses, playsuits, skirts, shoes and accessories through hellomolly.com, built on influencer and social-first marketing.

evidence.summary: Lasso's HelloMolly (US) record lists commission tiers of 4% and 6.4% with a 30-day cookie, and its join link routes to FlexOffers Publisher Pro; the 4% base tier is the rate recorded.

Netinfluencer documents Hello Molly's influencer program running alongside the affiliate program - the brand recruits creators matching its young, vibrant image and reports affiliate earnings of up to 7% on influencer links, with an average order around $100.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure trend-driven women's fashion - dresses and occasionwear made for try-on and event content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Influencer marketing is the brand's core growth channel, with a documented influencer program beside the affiliate program.
reasons.compensation: 4% base tier on FlexOffers with a 6.4% higher tier and up to 7% reported for influencer links; no earnings cap is stated anywhere fetched.
reasons.contact_access: No published creator email was found on the pages fetched; access is through FlexOffers and influencer outreach.
reasons.credibility: Well-known Australian fast-fashion retailer with a large social following and US storefront.

name: Gorjana
description: Laguna Beach jewelry brand founded in 2004 by Gorjana and Jason Reidel, selling layerable gold everyday jewelry - necklaces, earrings, bracelets and rings - through gorjana.com and its own boutiques.

evidence.summary: Brandid's 2026 jewelry affiliate roundup lists Gorjana at about 7% to 8% commission with a 30-day cookie on ShareASale, pitched for layering and everyday-outfit content.
Lasso lists 10% per sale with a 30-day cookie and an older CJ spotlight also cited 10%, conflicting with the 7-8% ShareASale figure, so commission_rate is null with the conflict documented here.
Sovrn's merchant page confirms Gorjana is a jewelry brand founded in 2004 by husband-and-wife team Gorjana and Jason Reidel in Laguna Beach, California.

reasons.niche_fit: Everyday layerable jewelry - a staple of outfit, stacking and capsule-wardrobe content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A DTC jewelry brand whose look is built for Instagram and Pinterest creator content, with programs on ShareASale and Sovrn.
reasons.compensation: Reported rates conflict between 7-8% (ShareASale) and 10% (Lasso/CJ), so no rate is recorded; no earnings cap is stated anywhere fetched.
reasons.contact_access: No published creator or partnerships contact was found; access is network-only.
reasons.credibility: Established 2004 DTC jewelry brand with its own retail boutiques.
